verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्रतिहते ऽस्त्रे तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।क्रोधं च द्विगुणं चक्रे क्रोधाच्चास्त्रमनन्तरम् ।। ६.१०१.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।krodhaṁ ca dviguṇaṁ cakre krodhāccāstramanantaram ।। 6.101.1 ।।

translations.english: Missile being counteracted, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, doubled the army later in anger.
translations.hindi: किन € ९ चतुनवतितमः सगः र स प्रविश्य सभां राजा दीनः परमदुःखितः । निषसादासने मुख्ये सिंहः क्रुद्ध इव शवसन्‌

verses.sloka: मयेन विहितं रौद्रमन्यदस्त्रं महाद्युतिः ।उत्स्रष्टुं रावणो घोरं राघवाय प्रचक्रमे ।। ६.१०१.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mayena vihitaṁ raudramanyadastraṁ mahādyutiḥ ।utsraṣṭuṁ rāvaṇo ghoraṁ rāghavāya pracakrame ।। 6.101.2 ।।

translations.english: Highly effulgent Ravana used another terrific missile, presided over by Rudra, produced by Maya.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर उस महाबलवान रावण ने पुत्रशोक से बिकल होने के कारण, हाथ जोड़ कर, उन समस्त राचससेनापतियों से कहा

verses.sloka: ततः शूलानि निश्चेरुर्गदाश्च मुसलानि च ।कार्मुकाद्दीप्यमानानि वज्रसाराणि सर्वशः ।। ६.१०१.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śūlāni niścerurgadāśca musalāni ca ।kārmukāddīpyamānāni vajrasārāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।। 6.101.3 ।।

translations.english: Then from his bow issued forth all over flaming tridents, maces, and iron bars like thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: आप सब लोग हाथियों पर चढ़ कर लड़ने वाले सैनिकों को, घुड्सवार सेना को तथा रथ सें बैठ कर लड़ने बाले सैनिकों को एवं पेद्ल योद्धाओं को साथ ले, लड़ने के लिए (नकलिए

verses.sloka: मुद्गराः कूटपाशाश्च दीप्ताश्चाशनयस्तथा ।निष्पेतुर्विविधास्तीक्ष्णा वाता इव युगक्षये ।। ६.१०१.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: mudgarāḥ kūṭapāśāśca dīptāścāśanayastathā ।niṣpeturvividhāstīkṣṇā vātā iva yugakṣaye ।। 6.101.4 ।।

translations.english: Several kinds of sharp multitudes of weapons and flaming thunderbolts issued forth like gales at the time of universal destruction.

verses.sloka: तदस्त्रं राघवः श्रीमानुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः ।जघान परमास्त्रेण गान्धर्वेण महाद्युतिः ।। ६.१०१.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadastraṁ rāghavaḥ śrīmānuttamāstravidāṁ varaḥ ।jaghāna paramāstreṇa gāndharveṇa mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.101.5 ।।

translations.english: Glorious Raghava, who is the best of those proficient in the use of missiles endowed with great splendour, neutralized that missile (of Ravana) with the missile presided over by Gandharvas.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्रतिहते ऽस्त्रे तु राघवेण महात्मना ।रावणः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सौरमस्त्रमुदैरयत् ।। ६.१०१.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।rāvaṇaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ sauramastramudairayat ।। 6.101.6 ।।

translations.english: When the missile of Ravana was turned void by the great selfRaghava, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger, and he used a missile presided over by the Sun God.

verses.sloka: ततश्चक्राणि निष्पेतुर्भास्वराणि महान्ति च ।कार्मुकाद्भीमवेगस्य दशग्रीवस्य धीमतः ।। ६.१०१.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataścakrāṇi niṣpeturbhāsvarāṇi mahānti ca ।kārmukādbhīmavegasya daśagrīvasya dhīmataḥ ।। 6.101.7 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, brilliant discus of the Sun God, issued forth from wise Ravana's bow at a terrific speed.
translations.hindi: यद्धक्ेत्र में पहुँच वे शरीरों को नष्ट कर डालने वाले परिघों, पटो, बाणों, तलदारों और परश्वधों को वानरों के ऊपर चलाने लगे

verses.sloka: तैरासीद्गगनं दीप्तं सम्पतद्भिरितस्ततः ।पतद्भिश्च दिशो दीप्ताश्चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहैरिव ।। ६.१०१.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tairāsīdgaganaṁ dīptaṁ sampatadbhiritastataḥ ।patadbhiśca diśo dīptāścandrasūryagrahairiva ।। 6.101.8 ।।

translations.english: As they landed together from the sky glowing like Sun, moon, and the planets, it illuminated the quarters.
translations.hindi: इसके उत्तर में वानरों ने उन राक्षसा के ऊपर वृक्षों और शिलाओं को केंका । सूर्योदय होते ही युद्ध आरम्भ हुआ और यह युद्ध बढ़ा भयङ्कर हुआ ॥=॥ रक्षसां वानराणां च तुमुलः समपद्यत । ~ घे ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः मासैः खङ्गैः परश्वधेः

verses.sloka: तानि चिच्छेद बाणौघैश्चक्राणि स तु राघवः ।आयुधानि च चित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे ।। ६.१०१.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāni ciccheda bāṇaughaiścakrāṇi sa tu rāghavaḥ ।āyudhāni ca citrāṇi rāvaṇasya camūmukhe ।। 6.101.9 ।।

translations.english: Raghava with his shafts shattered the discuses and the weapons of Ravana in the forefront of his army.

verses.sloka: तदस्त्रं तु हतं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।विव्याध दशभिर्बाणै रामं सर्वेषु मर्मसु ।। ६.१०१.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tadastraṁ tu hataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।vivyādha daśabhirbāṇai rāmaṁ sarveṣu marmasu ।। 6.101.10 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa king, frustrated on seeing the missiles, pierced Rama in his private parts with shafts.
translations.hindi: लड़ते हुए वानर और राक्षस, एक दूसरे पर प्रहार करने लगे । इस प्रकार युद्ध दोने पर समरभूमि में बड़ी धूल उड़ी

verses.sloka: स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैर्महाकार्मुकनिस्सृतैः ।रावणेन महातेजा न प्राकम्पत राघवः ।। ६.१०१.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa viddho daśabhirbāṇairmahākārmukanissṛtaiḥ ।rāvaṇena mahātejā na prākampata rāghavaḥ ।। 6.101.11 ।।

translations.english: Even though pierced by Ravana with ten arrows, Rama, endowed with high energy, was not shaken.
translations.hindi: त्य कणा या. १०२८ युद्धकाण्डे किन्तु ( मरे और घायल हुए ) बानरों के खून के बहने से बह धूल दब गई । इस युद्ध में इतना रक्त वहा कि, नदियाँ बह निकलीं । इन नदियों के, हाथी और रथ तो करारे थे, घोड़े मत्स्य थे ओर ध्वजाएँ नदीतटबर्ती वृक्ष थीं

verses.sloka: ततो विव्याध गात्रेषु सर्वेषु समितिञ्जयः ।राघवस्तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धो रावणं बहुभिः शरैः ।। ६.१०१.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato vivyādha gātreṣu sarveṣu samitiñjayaḥ ।rāghavastu susaṅkruddho rāvaṇaṁ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.101.12 ।।

translations.english: Then, Raghava, who had won many battles, became highly furious, piercing Ravana in all his limbs with many arrows.
translations.hindi: इन रक्त की नदियों में लोथें घरनई समान उतरा रही थीं। रुधिर में तराबोर, दे समस्त वानर उछल उछल कर राक्षसों की ध्वजाओं, कवचों, रथों, घोड़ों तथा विविध प्रकार के आयुधों को तोड़ फोड़ रहे थे

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राघवस्यानुजो बली ।लक्ष्मणः सायकान् सप्त जग्राह परवीरहा ।। ६.१०१.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare kruddho rāghavasyānujo balī ।lakṣmaṇaḥ sāyakān sapta jagrāha paravīrahā ।। 6.101.13 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, enraged Lakshmana, the brother of Rama, a mighty warrior, seized hold of seven shafts.

verses.sloka: तैः सायकैर्महावेगै रावणस्य महाद्युतिः ।ध्वजं मनुष्यशीर्षं तु तस्य चिच्छेद नैकधा ।। ६.१०१.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: taiḥ sāyakairmahāvegai rāvaṇasya mahādyutiḥ ।dhvajaṁ manuṣyaśīrṣaṁ tu tasya ciccheda naikadhā ।। 6.101.14 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, who was endowed with extraordinary splendour, for his part, with his shafts which had great force, shattered the device of man's head on the flag post of Ravana.
translations.hindi: “> वानर लोग, राक्षसों के सिर के बालों, कानों, ललाटो और नाकों को अपने पेने पेने दांतो और नखों से बकोट रहे थे

verses.sloka: सारथेश्चापि बाणेन शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् ।जहार लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नैर्ऋतस्य महाबलः ।। ६.१०१.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sāratheścāpi bāṇena śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam ।jahāra lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīmān nairṛtasya mahābalaḥ ।। 6.101.15 ।।

translations.english: Celebrated, mighty Lakshmana struck with his arrows, that hit the head of the charioteer of night ranger, which was glittering with earrings.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार किसी फले हुए वृक्ष के ऊपर सैकड़ों पक्षी टूटते हैं उसी प्रकार कहीं कहीं एक एक राक्षस के ऊपर सौ सौ वानर टूट पडते थे

verses.sloka: तस्य बाणैश्च चिच्छेद धनुर्गजकरोपमम् ।लक्ष्मणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.१०१.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya bāṇaiśca ciccheda dhanurgajakaropamam ।lakṣmaṇo rākṣasendrasya pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.101.16 ।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana split with five sharpened arrows the bow of Rakshasa king that resembled elephant's trunk.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी राक्षसी सेना में बैसे ही घुसे ; जैसे सूर्य मेघ मण्डल में घुस जाते हैं। बाणों की आग से जलाते हुए, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सामने राक्षस लोग नहीं ठहर सके

verses.sloka: नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्य सदश्वान् पर्वतोपमान् ।जघानाप्लुत्य गदया रावणस्य विभीषणः ।। ६.१०१.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: nīlameghanibhāṁścāsya sadaśvān parvatopamān ।jaghānāplutya gadayā rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.17 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana struck with his formidable mace the horses of Ravana which were like dark clouds and huge like mountains.

verses.sloka: हताश्वाद्वेगवान् वेगादवप्लुत्य महारथात् ।क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं भ्रातरं प्रति रावणः ।। ६.१०१.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatāśvādvegavān vegādavaplutya mahārathāt ।krodhamāhārayattīvraṁ bhrātaraṁ prati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.18 ।।

translations.english: With the horses of his chariot dead, Ravana descended from the huge chariot and exhibited violent rage against his brother.

verses.sloka: ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिर्दीप्तां दींप्ताशनीमिव ।विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.१०१.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaktiṁ mahāśaktirdīptāṁ dīṁptāśanīmiva ।vibhīṣaṇāya cikṣepa rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.101.19 ।।

translations.english: Then, endowed with extraordinary energy, the powerful leader of Rakshasas hurled a flaming thunderbolt like javelin at Vibheeshana.

verses.sloka: अप्राप्तामेव तां बाणैस्त्रिभिश्चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः ।अथोदतिष्ठत् सन्नादो वानराणां तदा रणे ।। ६.१०१.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: aprāptāmeva tāṁ bāṇaistribhiściccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ ।athodatiṣṭhat sannādo vānarāṇāṁ tadā raṇe ।। 6.101.20 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana shattered the javelin with three shafts even before it reached him (Vibheeshana). Then the Vanaras raised loud cheer in that huge conflict.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी इस युद्ध में बड़े बड़े भयङ्कर कमे कर रहे थे। वे ऐसे कर्म थे, जिन्हें, अन्य कोई वीर नहीं कर सकता था। राक्षस लोग अपनी सेना का नाश होना देखते थे, ( किन्तु नाश करने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्रजी किस कर्म द्वारा अथवा किस प्रकार _ नाश कर रहे थे; यह उनको दही दिखलाइ पड़ता था | अर्थात्‌ बडी फुर्ती से श्रीरामचन्द्र जी बाणवृष्टि कर रहे थे । )

verses.sloka: सा पपात त्रिधा च्छिन्ना शक्तिः काञ्चनमालिनी ।सविस्फुलिङ्गा ज्वलिता महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता ।। ६.१०१.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā papāta tridhā cchinnā śaktiḥ kāñcanamālinī ।savisphuliṅgā jvalitā maholkeva divaścyutā ।। 6.101.21 ।।

translations.english: The javelin, which was covered with gold, broke into three parts, and fell down like a huge meteor emitting fire sparks from the heavens.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे चालयन्तं सहानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान्‌ | दइशुस्ते न बै राम घातं वनगत यथा ॥२ १] जिस प्रकार शरीर में लगने से वन का पवन जाना जाता है, उसो प्रकार श्रीरामचन्द्र जी भो राक्षसो सेना को चलायमान अर महारथियों को दलन करते हुए अनुमान द्वारा जान लिए जाते थे, परन्तु कोई भी राक्षस उनको देख नहीं पाता था। (अर्थात्‌ जिस प्रकार पचन का काय, वृक्षादि के पत्ता का हिलना दिखलाई पड़ता है, स्वयं पवन नहीं देख पड़ता, उसो प्रकार श्रोगामचन्द्र स्वयं तो नहीं देख पड़ते थे, किन्तु राक्षसलंहारादि उनके कार्य सव को दिखलाई पड़ते थे, । )

verses.sloka: ततः सम्भाविततरां कालेनापि दुरासदाम् ।जग्राह विपुलां शक्तिं दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा ।। ६.१०१.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sambhāvitatarāṁ kālenāpi durāsadām ।jagrāha vipulāṁ śaktiṁ dīpyamānāṁ svatejasā ।। 6.101.22 ।।

translations.english: Then, Ravana seized hold of a huge javelin shining with its own splendour, a formidable one even for the god of death.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी द्वारा खण्डित, बिढाण, शराम्नि से द्ग्घ, टुकड़े टुकड़े हुई तथा बाणों से पोड़ित राक्षसी सेना तो देख पड़ती थी, किन्तु फुतीले श्रारामचन्द्र जी नहीं देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: सा वेगिता बलवता रावणेन दुरासदा ।जज्वाल सुमहाघोरा शक्राशनिसमप्रभा ।। ६.१०१.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā vegitā balavatā rāvaṇena durāsadā ।jajvāla sumahāghorā śakrāśanisamaprabhā ।। 6.101.23 ।।

translations.english: That javelin was endowed with speed, resembling thunderbolt in splendour, whirled round by the mighty and evilminded Ravana, shone.
translations.hindi: जिन राक्षसां के रारीरों में चोट लगती थो, वे भी रामचन्द्र जी को वैसे ही नहीं देख पाते थे, जैसे इन्द्रियों के सुखभोग में फंसे प्राणो जीवात्मा को नहीं देख पाते

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो लक्ष्मणस्तं विभीषणम् ।प्राणसंशयमापन्नं तूर्णमभ्यवपद्यत ।। ६.१०१.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vīro lakṣmaṇastaṁ vibhīṣaṇam ।prāṇasaṁśayamāpannaṁ tūrṇamabhyavapadyata ।। 6.101.24 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, seeing Vibheeshana's life in danger, heroic Lakshmana reached him and stood obstructing (the javelin).
translations.hindi: यह देखो राम हाथियों "की सेना का संहार कर रहा है यह्‌ देखो, राम हाथियों को नष्ट किए डालता है, यद्द देखो पेने पैने तीरों घे राम घड़सवारों ओर पैदल राक्षस योद्धाओं को मारे डालता है

verses.sloka: तं विमोक्षयितुं वीरश्चापमायम्य लक्ष्मणः ।रावणं शक्तिहस्तं वै शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।। ६.१०१.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vimokṣayituṁ vīraścāpamāyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ śaktihastaṁ vai śaravarṣairavākirat ।। 6.101.25 ।।

translations.english: Heroic Lakshmana stretched his bow and showered volley of arrows and covered Ravana who held javelin in hand.

verses.sloka: कीर्यमाणः शरौघेण विसृष्टेन महात्मना ।स प्रहर्तुं मनश्चक्रे विमुखीकृतविक्रमः ।। ६.१०१.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kīryamāṇaḥ śaraugheṇa visṛṣṭena mahātmanā ।sa prahartuṁ manaścakre vimukhīkṛtavikramaḥ ।। 6.101.26 ।।

translations.english: Covered by the stream of shafts discharged by the great self, Lakshmana, Ravana could not shake his hand and was not inclined in his mind to strike (Vibheeshana).
translations.hindi: शत्रसेन्य को भस्म करते हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को वे रास नहीं देख सके । क्योंकि महाबली श्रीरामचन्द्र जो ने परमात्म गन्धर्वा से उन सब को मोहित कर दिआ था

verses.sloka: मोक्षितं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणेन स रावणः ।लक्ष्मणाभिमुखस्तिष्ठन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१०१.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: mokṣitaṁ bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇena sa rāvaṇaḥ ।lakṣmaṇābhimukhastiṣṭhannidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.101.27 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke Ravana seeing Lakshmana who stood facing him, who rescued his brother (Vibheeshana).
translations.hindi: कभी तो उन रात्तसों को युद्धभूमि में हजारों.श्रोराम चन्द्र दिखलाई पड़ते और कभी वे एक ही श्रारामचन्द्र जो को देखते थे

verses.sloka: मोक्षितस्ते बलश्लाघिन् यस्मादेवं विभीषणः ।विमुच्य राक्षसं शक्तिस्त्वयीयं विनिपात्यते ।। ६.१०१.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mokṣitaste balaślāghin yasmādevaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।vimucya rākṣasaṁ śaktistvayīyaṁ vinipātyate ।। 6.101.28 ।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana! You are proud of your might of rescuing Vibheeshana. Now this javelin released from me will strike at you."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे वे राक्षस लोग, महाबलवान्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सुवर्णमय > ~ ने ४. धनुष का अग्रभाग, अघजली ओर घूमती हुई, बनैटी की तरह सदा मण्डलाकार ही देखते थे; किन्तु उन्हें श्रीरामचन्द्र जी नहीं देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: एषा ते हृदयं भित्त्वा शक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा ।मद्बाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टा प्राणानादाय यास्यति ।। ६.१०१.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā te hṛdayaṁ bhittvā śaktirlohitalakṣaṇā ।madbāhuparighotsṛṣṭā prāṇānādāya yāsyati ।। 6.101.29 ।।

translations.english: "This javelin released by my bludgeonlike arm will pierce your heart and take away your life."

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां शक्तिमष्टघण्टां महास्वनाम् ।मयेन मायाविहिताममोघां शत्रुघातिनीम् ।। ६.१०१.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā tāṁ śaktimaṣṭaghaṇṭāṁ mahāsvanām ।mayena māyāvihitāmamoghāṁ śatrughātinīm ।। 6.101.30 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Ravana, having spoken in this manner, hurled the javelin adorned with eight bells making loud noise, designed magically by Maya, a stupendous one capable of destroying any enemy, which was glowing with shine, aiming at Lakshmana, and roared aloud.
translations.hindi: के रण में घूमते हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के धनुषरू समय कालचक्र की तरह योद्धाओं ने देखा

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणाय समुद्दिश्य ज्वलन्तीमिव तेजसा ।रावणः परमक्रुद्धश्चिक्षेप च ननाद च ।। ६.१०१.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇāya samuddiśya jvalantīmiva tejasā ।rāvaṇaḥ paramakruddhaścikṣepa ca nanāda ca ।। 6.101.31 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Ravana, having spoken in this manner, hurled the javelin adorned with eight bells making loud noise, designed magically by Maya, a stupendous one capable of destroying any enemy, which was glowing with shine, aiming at Lakshmana, and roared aloud.
translations.hindi: वायु के वेग की तरह वेग से चलने वाले दस सहस्र रथों ( ओर उनमें बैठे योद्धाओं ) को, अठारह सहस्र वेगवान्‌ हाथियों ( और उन पर बैठ कर लड़ने वाले योद्धाओं ) को, चौदह सहस्न घोड़ों और उन पर सवार योद्धओं को और पूरे दो लाख पैदल कामरूपी राक्षस सैनिकों को, अकेले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने पौने चार घड़ियों में अपने अभिशिखा के समान चमकते हुए बाणों से मार डाला

verses.sloka: सा क्षिप्ता भीमवेगेन शक्राशनिसमस्वना ।शक्तिरभ्यपतद्वेगाल्लक्ष्मणं रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.१०१.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā kṣiptā bhīmavegena śakrāśanisamasvanā ।śaktirabhyapatadvegāllakṣmaṇaṁ raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.101.32 ।।

translations.english: Hurled at terrific speed, that javelin, which was equal to thunderbolt, speedily went towards Lakshmana in the forefront of war.

verses.sloka: तामनुव्याहरच्छक्तिमापतन्तीं स राघवः ।स्वस्त्यस्तु लक्ष्मणायेति मोघा भव हतोद्यमा ।। ६.१०१.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmanuvyāharacchaktimāpatantīṁ sa rāghavaḥ ।svastyastu lakṣmaṇāyeti moghā bhava hatodyamā ।। 6.101.33 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the javelin coming towards Lakshmana, Raghava said 'May Lakshmana be auspicious. May he be well. May your attempt to kill Lakshmana be ineffective and wasted'.

verses.sloka: रावणेन रणे शक्तिः क्रुद्धेनाशीविषोपमा ।मुक्ता ऽ ऽशूरस्यभीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य ममज्ज सा ।। ६.१०१.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇena raṇe śaktiḥ kruddhenāśīviṣopamā ।muktā ' 'śūrasyabhītasya lakṣmaṇasya mamajja sā ।। 6.101.34 ।।

translations.english: Released by Ravana in anger, that javelin, which was like poison of venomous serpent, pierced into the chest of Lakshmana who stood fearless.
translations.hindi: लड़ने के लिए आई हुई उस राक्षसी सेना में थोड़े ही राक्षस रह गए थे, उनमें कितनों ह्वी के तो घोड़े मारे गए थे और कितनों ही के रथ टुकड़े टुकडे हो गये थे; ध्वजाएँ कट गई थीं | उनका रणोत्साह एकदम शान्त हो गया था । मरने से बचे हुए ऐसे राक्षस लङ्कापुरी में पहुँचे

verses.sloka: न्यपतत् सा महावेगा लक्ष्मणस्य महोरसि ।जिह्वेवोरगराजस्य दीप्यमाना महाद्युतिः ।। ६.१०१.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nyapatat sā mahāvegā lakṣmaṇasya mahorasi ।jihvevoragarājasya dīpyamānā mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.101.35 ।।

translations.english: Glowing like the tongue of Vasuki, the king of serpents, flaming, त्त्जवेलिन descended at high speed on the chest of Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: मरे हुए हाथियों, पैदल सेनिकों और घोड़ों से पट कर, रण- भूमि ऐसी जान पड़ती थी, मानों बह कुपित महाबलवान्‌ भगवान्‌ रुद्र की क्रोडास्थली हो

verses.sloka: ततो रावणवेगेन सुदूरमवगाढया ।शक्त्या निर्भिन्नहृदयः पपात भुवि लक्ष्मणः ।। ६.१०१.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāvaṇavegena sudūramavagāḍhayā ।śaktyā nirbhinnahṛdayaḥ papāta bhuvi lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.36 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Lakshmana fell on the ground, pierced by the javelin, deep into the heart from far with great force by Ravana.
translations.hindi: वा० रा[० य्‌०-— ६५ १०३४ युद्धकाण्डे देवता, गन्धर्वे, सिद्ध और महर्षि श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के इस पराक्रम को देख, और “ धन्य धन्य ” कह कर, उनकी बडी प्रशंसा कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: तदवस्थं समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः ।भ्रातृस्नेहान्महातेजा विषण्णहृदयो ऽभवत् ।। ६.१०१.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadavasthaṁ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaṁ prekṣya rāghavaḥ ।bhrātṛsnehānmahātejā viṣaṇṇahṛdayo 'bhavat ।। 6.101.37 ।।

translations.english: Watching Lakshmana in that situation, most courageous Raghava, out of brotherly affection felt despondent at heart.
translations.hindi: तब पास खड़े हुए सुग्रीव से विभीषण, हनुमान, जाम्बवान, कपिश्रेष्ठ मैन्द और द्विबिद से धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने कहा-- इस प्रकार की अञ्जप्रयोगशाक्त तो मुझमें है या शिव जी में हे

verses.sloka: स मुहूर्तमनुध्याय बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।बभूव संरब्धतरो युगान्त इव पावकः ।। ६.१०१.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa muhūrtamanudhyāya bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ।babhūva saṁrabdhataro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.101.38 ।।

translations.english: He (Raghava) stood confused for a short while as it was, his eyes filled with tears like fire at the end of the universe.

verses.sloka: न विषादस्य कालो ऽयमिति सञ्चिन्त्य राघवः ।चक्रे सुतुमुलं युद्धं रावणस्य वधे धृतः ।सर्वयत्नेन महता लक्ष्मणं सन्निरीक्ष्य च ।। ६.१०१.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: na viṣādasya kālo 'yamiti sañcintya rāghavaḥ ।cakre sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ rāvaṇasya vadhe dhṛtaḥ ।sarvayatnena mahatā lakṣmaṇaṁ sannirīkṣya ca ।। 6.101.39 ।।

translations.english: Realizing that this is not the time to be disconsolate, observing Lakshmana's efforts, Raghava resolved to destroy Ravana and started a fierce struggle.

verses.sloka: स ददर्श ततो रामः शक्त्या भिन्नं महाहवे ।लक्ष्मणं रुधिरादिग्धं सपन्नगमिवाचलम् ।। ६.१०१.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa tato rāmaḥ śaktyā bhinnaṁ mahāhave ।lakṣmaṇaṁ rudhirādigdhaṁ sapannagamivācalam ।। 6.101.40 ।।

translations.english: Rama beheld Lakshmana pierced with javelin in the great war bathed in blood and resembling a mountain with a snake penetrated into it.

verses.sloka: तामपि प्रहितां शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा ।यत्नतस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम् ।। ६.१०१.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmapi prahitāṁ śaktiṁ rāvaṇena balīyasā ।yatnataste hariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum ।। 6.101.41 ।।

translations.english: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.

verses.sloka: अर्दिताश्चैव बाणौघैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा ।। ६.१०१.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: arditāścaiva bāṇaughaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā ।। 6.101.42 ।।

translations.english: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.

verses.sloka: सौमित्रिं सा विनिर्भिद्य प्रविष्टा धरणीतलम् ।। ६.१०१.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: saumitriṁ sā vinirbhidya praviṣṭā dharaṇītalam ।। 6.101.43 ।।

translations.english: It pierced through Lakshmana's body and entered into the earth. Mighty Rama held the terrific javelin with both hands bent it and removed in the course of struggle.

verses.sloka: तां कराभ्यां परामृश्य रामः शक्तिं भयावहाम् ।बभञ्ज समरे क्रुद्धो बलवान् विचकर्ष च ।। ६.१०१.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ karābhyāṁ parāmṛśya rāmaḥ śaktiṁ bhayāvahām ।babhañja samare kruddho balavān vicakarṣa ca ।। 6.101.44 ।।

translations.english: While Rama was pulling out the javelin, mighty and courageous Ravana struck him in his private parts and all over the body with arrows.

verses.sloka: तस्य निष्कर्षतः शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा ।शराः सर्वेषु गात्रेषु पातिता मर्मभेदिनः ।। ६.१०१.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya niṣkarṣataḥ śaktiṁ rāvaṇena balīyasā ।śarāḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu pātitā marmabhedinaḥ ।। 6.101.45 ।।

translations.english: Not minding the arrows struck, Rama embraced Lakshmana and spoke to Hanumantha and the great Vanara Sugriva.

verses.sloka: अचिन्तयित्वा तान् बाणान् समाश्लिष्य च लक्ष्णमम् ।अब्रवीच्छ हनूमन्तं सुग्रीवं चैव राघवः ।। ६.१०१.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: acintayitvā tān bāṇān samāśliṣya ca lakṣṇamam ।abravīccha hanūmantaṁ sugrīvaṁ caiva rāghavaḥ ।। 6.101.46 ।।

translations.english: "O foremost of Vanaras! Take care of Lakshmana by surrounding him. Just as clouds appeared before the chataka bird waiting for long, time has come to exhibit my valour which was awaited for long. Now I will destroy the ten headed Ravana of sinful resolve rightfully in a short while from now."

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणं परिवार्येह तिष्ठध्वं वानरोत्तमाः ।। ६.१०१.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaṁ parivāryeha tiṣṭhadhvaṁ vānarottamāḥ ।। 6.101.47 ।।

translations.english: 'In this very hour I make you a true promise: O monkeys, you shall soon behold this world rid of Ravana — or rid of Rama.'

verses.sloka: पराक्रमस्य कालो ऽयं सम्प्राप्तो मे चिरेप्सितः ।पापात्मा ऽयं दशग्रीवो वध्यतां पापनिश्चयः ।काङ्क्षतः स्तोककस्येव घर्मान्ते मेघदर्शनम् ।। ६.१०१.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: parākramasya kālo 'yaṁ samprāpto me cirepsitaḥ ।pāpātmā 'yaṁ daśagrīvo vadhyatāṁ pāpaniścayaḥ ।kāṅkṣataḥ stokakasyeva gharmānte meghadarśanam ।। 6.101.48 ।।

translations.english: 'The loss of the kingdom, the dwelling in the forest, the wandering through Dandaka, the outrage done to Vaidehi, the clash with the rakshasas—'

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते न चिरात् सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि वः ।अरावणमरामं वा जगद्द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः ।। ६.१०१.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin muhūrte na cirāt satyaṁ pratiśṛṇomi vaḥ ।arāvaṇamarāmaṁ vā jagaddrakṣyatha vānarāḥ ।। 6.101.49 ।।

translations.english: '—all that great and terrible sorrow, that anguish like unto hell, I shall cast off this day by slaying Ravana in battle.'

verses.sloka: राज्यनाशं वने वासं दण्डके परिधावनम् ।वैदेह्याश्च परामर्शं रक्षोभिश्च समागमम् ।। ६.१०१.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: rājyanāśaṁ vane vāsaṁ daṇḍake paridhāvanam ।vaidehyāśca parāmarśaṁ rakṣobhiśca samāgamam ।। 6.101.50 ।।

translations.english: 'He for whose sake this army of monkeys was gathered by me, for whose sake Sugriva was set upon the throne when Vali had been slain in combat, for whose sake the ocean was crossed and a bridge bound over it—'

verses.sloka: प्राप्तं दुःखं महद्घोरं क्लेशं च निरयोपमम् ।अद्य सर्वमहं त्यक्ष्ये निहत्वा रावणं रणे ।। ६.१०१.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāptaṁ duḥkhaṁ mahadghoraṁ kleśaṁ ca nirayopamam ।adya sarvamahaṁ tyakṣye nihatvā rāvaṇaṁ raṇe ।। 6.101.51 ।।

translations.english: '—that sinner has this day come within the range of my sight in battle; and having come within my sight, he cannot live.'

verses.sloka: यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया ।सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे ।। ६.१०१.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadarthaṁ vānaraṁ sainyaṁ samānītamidaṁ mayā ।sugrīvaśca kṛto rājye nihatvā vālinaṁ raṇe ।। 6.101.52 ।।

translations.english: 'My glance has fallen upon Ravana as the glance of a serpent whose very look is venom — like a snake fallen under the gaze of Vinata's son, he cannot escape.'

verses.sloka: यदर्थं सागरः क्रान्तः सेतुर्बद्धश्च सागरे ।सो ऽयमद्य रणे पापश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः ।। ६.१०१.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadarthaṁ sāgaraḥ krāntaḥ seturbaddhaśca sāgare ।so 'yamadya raṇe pāpaścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ ।। 6.101.53 ।।

translations.english: 'Seat yourselves at ease upon the mountain-tops, O invincible bulls among monkeys, and behold this battle — this fight is mine and Ravana's.'

verses.sloka: चक्षुर्विषयमागम्य नायं जीवितुमर्हति ।दृष्टिं दृष्टिविषस्येव सर्पस्य मम रावणः ।। ६.१०१.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: cakṣurviṣayamāgamya nāyaṁ jīvitumarhati ।dṛṣṭiṁ dṛṣṭiviṣasyeva sarpasya mama rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.54 ।।

translations.english: 'Let the three worlds, with the gandharvas and the gods, with the rishis and charanas, behold this day upon the field what it is that makes Rama Rama.'

verses.sloka: स्वस्थाः पश्यत दुर्धर्षा युद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः ।आसीनाः पर्वताग्रेषु ममेदं रावणस्य च ।। ६.१०१.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: svasthāḥ paśyata durdharṣā yuddhaṁ vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।āsīnāḥ parvatāgreṣu mamedaṁ rāvaṇasya ca ।। 6.101.55 ।।

translations.english: 'Today I shall do such a deed as the worlds with all that moves and moves not, gods included, shall recount so long as the earth endures — telling ever, when men gather together, how this battle was fought.'

verses.sloka: अद्य रामस्य रामत्वं पश्यन्तु मम संयुगे ।त्रयो लोकाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवाः सर्षिचारणाः ।। ६.१०१.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya rāmasya rāmatvaṁ paśyantu mama saṁyuge ।trayo lokāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāḥ sarṣicāraṇāḥ ।। 6.101.56 ।।

translations.english: So saying, Rama with collected mind struck the ten-necked one in battle with sharp arrows adorned with burnished gold.

verses.sloka: अद्य कर्म करिष्यामि यल्लोकाः सचराचराः ।सदेवाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति ।समागम्य सदा लोके यथा युद्धं प्रवर्तितम् ।। ६.१०१.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya karma kariṣyāmi yallokāḥ sacarācarāḥ ।sadevāḥ kathayiṣyanti yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati ।samāgamya sadā loke yathā yuddhaṁ pravartitam ।। 6.101.57 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana in his turn rained blazing steel shafts and clubs upon Rama, as a cloud pours down its torrents.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः ।आजघान दशग्रीवं रणे रामः समाहितः ।। ६.१०१.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā śitairbāṇaistaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।ājaghāna daśagrīvaṁ raṇe rāmaḥ samāhitaḥ ।। 6.101.58 ।।

translations.english: A tumultuous din arose of the arrows loosed by Rama and by Ravana clashing against one another.

verses.sloka: अथ प्रदीप्तैर्नाराचैर्मुसलैश्चापि रावणः ।अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं धाराभिरिव तोयदः ।। ६.१०१.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha pradīptairnārācairmusalaiścāpi rāvaṇaḥ ।abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ dhārābhiriva toyadaḥ ।। 6.101.59 ।।

translations.english: Shattered and scattered, those arrows of Rama and of Ravana, their points ablaze, fell from the sky upon the earth.

verses.sloka: रामरावणमुक्तानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम् ।शराणां च शराणां च बभूव तुमुलः स्वनः ।। ६.१०१.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmarāvaṇamuktānāmanyonyamabhinighnatām ।śarāṇāṁ ca śarāṇāṁ ca babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ ।। 6.101.60 ।।

translations.english: The great twang of the bowstrings of Rama and Ravana, wondrous beyond compare, struck terror into all beings.

verses.sloka: ते भिन्नाश्च विकीर्णाश्च रामरावणयोः शराः ।अन्तरिक्षात् प्रदीप्ताग्रा निपेतुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.१०१.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: te bhinnāśca vikīrṇāśca rāmarāvaṇayoḥ śarāḥ ।antarikṣāt pradīptāgrā nipeturdharaṇītale ।। 6.101.61 ।।

translations.english: Showered upon and afflicted by the volleys of arrows of that great-souled wielder of the flaming bow, Ravana turned and fled in fear, as a cloud driven before the gale.

verses.sloka: तयोर्ज्यातलनिर्घोषो रामरावणयोर्महान् ।त्रासनः सर्वभूतानां सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः ।। ६.१०१.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayorjyātalanirghoṣo rāmarāvaṇayormahān ।trāsanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ ।। 6.101.62 ।।

verses.sloka: स कीर्यमाणः शरजालवृष्टिभिर्महात्मना दीप्तधनुष्मता ऽर्दितः ।भयात् प्रदुद्राव समेत्य रावणो यथा ऽनिलेनाभिहतो बलाहकः ।। ६.१०१.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kīryamāṇaḥ śarajālavṛṣṭibhirmahātmanā dīptadhanuṣmatā 'rditaḥ ।bhayāt pradudrāva sametya rāvaṇo yathā 'nilenābhihato balāhakaḥ ।। 6.101.63 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 101 ।।
